rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the protected body
first member of a compound denoting weapons
groups or masses of weapons as agents
action of being cut or split

items.question: Can the ritually protected body be pierced by multitudes of weapons?
premises: That body has been ritually protected as described.
Multitudes of weapons may strike that body.
The body is never pierced by those weapons.
items.inference: The ritually protected body remains invulnerable to piercing by weapons.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the protection depends on the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: That body is never pierced by multitudes of weapons.
